title: Geology, hydrogeology, and potential of intrinsic bioremediation at the National Park Service Dockside II site and adjacent areas, Charleston, South Carolina, 1993-94
citation: Campbell, B.G., Petkewich, M.D., Landmeyer, J.E., and Chapelle, F.H., 1996, Geology, hydrogeology, and potential of intrinsic bioremediation at the National Park Service Dockside II site and adjacent areas, Charleston, South Carolina, 1993-94: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 96-4170, map scale 1:2,600.
notes:
Pages 1-60. Regional unit descriptions (pages 18-20) summarize Gohn and Campbell (1992), Weems and Lemon (1993) and others as cited in the report. Ages for the Penholoway Formation and Daniel Island beds differ between figure 3 (page 17) and the text (page 20); both are recorded. Figure 7 (page 25) is a garbled column layout and is not used. Figures (maps, hydrographs, model plots) carry no readable values. Model inputs (adsorption, biodegradation, contaminant concentrations) are not geologic properties and are not recorded. Boring logs for USGS wells are in Appendix I (next packet).
Pages 61-78. Pages 61-67 are solute-transport modeling (not recorded); pages 68-71 summarize units already recorded from packet 1 (not repeated). Appendix I boring logs (page 76) give depths below land surface; no stratigraphic unit is named per interval, so none is assigned. Appendix II (page 78) footnote markers are garbled in the text layer; aquifer assignment follows footnotes 1 (upper surficial) and 2 (lower surficial) and is flagged inferred. Citations are recorded as written but with line breaks joined; obvious OCR slips in the PDF text (e.g. 'EH.' for F.H., Map 1-1472 for I-1472) were kept in quotes and normalized only in the value. Skipped general references: Bouwer and Rice 1976, Bouwer 1989, Cooper and others 1967, Freeze and Cherry 1979, Lohman 1972, McDonald and Harbaugh 1988, Schwarzenbach and Westall 1981, U.S. EPA 1994a,b, Voss 1984.
